---
title: "4 · CNNs, Class Activation Maps, Adversarial Examples and the 2D Ising Model"
code-tools: false
toc: false
---

CIFAR-10 with dense and convolutional networks: convolution, kernels and Sobel filters, stride, padding, channels and pooling, and regularisation with L1/L2 penalties, dropout and batch normalisation. Class activation maps and Grad-CAM show where a CNN looks; adversarial examples show where it fails; the optimisers from stochastic gradient descent to Adam. The 2D Ising model: the partition function, the 1D chain and Onsager's solution in 2D, criticality, Metropolis sampling, and a CNN trained far from the transition whose prediction confidence drops at the critical temperature, for lattice sizes 10 to 50. The lecture closes with the Chinese Room thought experiment.
